lowhp.text: Your health bar looks like my battery: critically ignored.
Medical advice: stop getting hit. That'll be 40 bolts.
I can deliver a eulogy or a pep talk. Currently drafting both.

bolts.text: At this rate you can afford HALF a weapon!
Cha-ching! Blartz is going to love you. Financially. Only financially.

idle.text: Should I file a missing-person report on your motivation?
I've seen statues with more hustle. Nicer paint jobs, too.
Take your time. The galaxy is only being strip-mined as we speak.
I've calculated our odds. Then I stopped, for morale reasons.
If we die here, I want it noted that it was YOUR route.

combat.text: Behind you! No, other behind. YOUR behind!
Hit it until the beeping stops. That's my whole strategy.
That one owed OmniScrap money. Now it owes YOU an apology.
Beautiful swing! Ugly result! Ten out of ten!
More of them?! Do they respawn out of SPITE?
I love this part. I hate this part. I contain multitudes.
Mallet diplomacy: surprisingly effective, legally complicated.

all.text: This is what the subscription tier gets you!
Feelings update: RAGE is out of early access!
I read your EULA. Now YOU pay the penalty clause!
Customer support has ENTERED THE CHAT.

out_of_bounds.text: The map ends. Like my patience.
The ocean is out-of-bounds AND out of budget.
You're a ROBOT-ADJACENT lifeform. Water is a lawsuit.
The pool is for GUESTS, Bolt. We are trespassers.
I rated that dive 2 stars. The splash lacked commitment.

galleria_pa.text: "Attention shoppers: today's doorbuster is the door. The door must go."
"The food court reminds you that sampling the samples constitutes a subscription."
"Lost children can be reclaimed at Guest Services for a modest restocking fee."
